summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice and proxy statement for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held November 25, 2026, at its Migdal Haemek offices. The sole agenda item is shareholder approval of an Amended and Restated Compensation Policy for directors and executive officers under the Israeli Companies Law, following the July 2026 meeting. The Board recommends voting FOR. Record date is October 19, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice and compensation-policy matter, not a special situation; no deal, stake, price, or advisor terms are stated.
